role: Read-only electrical analysis contributor; not independent reviewer of any final spec that adopts these calculations
method: Native circuit topology/approved graph plus cached exact manufacturer documents and independent arithmetic. No tests, simulations, vendor contact, current stock query or certification. Root alone owns CAD and deliverable documents.

nominal_current_and_power.basis: LYT1RevB07/16p4 RFB approximately VFB/(k*IOUT),k3.6; primary says trimming may be necessary. R8/R9 are in parallel with external LED. Steady capacitor average current is zero. Total output estimate includes bleed load; first-order LED current subtracts bleed.
nominal_current_and_power.limits: 135.203mA is not an exact guaranteed LED current.133.439mA is also only a first-order estimate: IC/current waveform/tolerances, R7/M sensing currents, line modulation, load voltage and temperature not completely modeled. Nominal134mA or approximately135mA class is appropriate. No circuit adjustment is needed solely to remove false arithmetic precision.
nominal_current_and_power.manufacturer_preload_guidance: Datasheet p4 recommends pre-load <=0.5% output power. Added dual68k pair is1.305% at60V; explicit faster-discharge/independence tradeoff increases standby/output loading relative to reference. Not automatically a functional prohibition.
nominal_current_and_power.load_window_limit: Arithmetic holds Itotal constant, not a validated regulation envelope.

loss_efficiency_input.chosen_boundary: TOTAL ALL BASE LOSSES including bleeders, RF1/MOV/bridge/filter/buck/sense/OVP and capacitor loss. LED board itself excluded. Do NOT add bleed a second time.
loss_efficiency_input.loss_bound_status: Allocation, not validated minimum/maximum and not a guaranteed range across all line/load/temperature.
loss_efficiency_input.input_RMS_equation: Irms=Pin/(Vrms*TRUE_power_factor). Pin/Vrms is only in-phase real-current equivalent, not generally RMS current. PF includes distortion; cos(phi) alone is insufficient.
loss_efficiency_input.PF_status: All0.9/0.94/0.95 scenarios are explicit hypotheses, not SC09 verified PF. No unconditional RMS maximum can be stated from output power alone.
loss_efficiency_input.bulk_DC_note: Input film filter is rectified mains, not a stiff regulated325V DC bus. Inrush/peak drain/current cannot be inferred from RMS power alone.

reference_observations_not_SC09.thermal_method: RDR open-frame assembly inside airflow-shielding acrylic enclosure. p27/28 IR camera25C; p30ff typeT thermocouples nominal75C chamber. Actual PCB, coil, output capacitor and bleeder loading differ.
reference_observations_not_SC09.inference_limit: Reference temperature rises/efficiency do not transfer as SC09 predictions. Different component positions can report RF1 below the selected internal ambient sensor; do not force that into a universal ambient-resistance model.

conditional_temperature_scenarios_not_pr.status: Illustrative sensitivity calculations T=Ta+Ploss*Rtheta. Assumed effective Rtheta ranges below are engineering assumptions requested by coordinator, NOT measurements, manufacturer values for this PCB, CFD or validated bounds. They may be wrong, including adverse enclosure and neighboring LED heating.

U1.published_reference_thetaJA_note: Datasheet p7 gives100K/W on232mm2of2oz or80K/W on645mm2of2oz. Current combined241.90mm2of1oz is NOT either reference board. Assumed120–200 range is not an extrapolated guaranteed rating.
U1.SOURCE_measurement_conditional: Using published thetaJC30K/W measured atSOURCE close to plastic: actual SOURCE100C with assumed.15–.35W implies modeled junction104.5–110.5C. Requires correct measurement location/loss/model.

T1.notes: Triangular current is a simplified equivalent, not verified mains-cycle waveform. Core loss allocation is not sourced calculation. Winding/core temperatures differ. At existing more conservative.300Arms and.4Wcore budget, total.724W requires effective<=69.06K/W to stay90C at40ambient.

R7.limit: Manufacturer VR25 model only under its mounting conditions; local ambient can differ from room. Do not call room40C the local ambient next to hot components without test.

D1.limit: Does not include reverse-recovery loss and does not predict terminal/case/ambient temperature. Need actual terminal temperature and appropriate model; case is not automatically terminal.

conditional_temperature_scenarios_not_pr.C6_and_other_parts: No credible absolute temperature forecast without loss/ESR/ripple and local thermal network. Keep explicit design targets/stop limits, not invented expected ranges.

magnetic_limits.hot_DC_bias_requirement: DemonstrateL>=.855mH at.6A at actual required hot winding/core condition; zero-bias1mH alone is insufficient.
magnetic_limits.fault_limit_status: LYT1x03 auto-restart limit1.06/1.15/1.24A at25C and specified current ramp is not a full-temperature coil current upper bound. Linear0.682T at1.24A exceeds plausiblePC40 operating saturation margin; indicates missing margin, not actual unsaturated flux. Fault minimum-on time has no published maximum. .6A custom coil test does not qualify1.24A fault operation.
magnetic_limits.normal_regulation_status: Existing min-on screen3.568% margin is conditional on.855mH hot/bias inductance and25C IC extrema. Do not guarantee regulated current at all corners.

can_close_before_order: Exact source, native connectivity/ERC/DRC/refill, measured-coordinate geometry and artwork/drill layer/parity checks.
Updated loss/output-current arithmetic and an honest conditional parameter sheet.
Actual owner acceptance of50x32mm removes earlier size-selection blocker if its exact decision is recorded.
Manufacturing capability/stackup/copper/finish/order preview and bare-board-only scope.
not_required_as_completed_measurement_be: Finished-lamp light output/efficiency and actual component temperatures cannot be measured before prototype; preserve these as later gates rather than inventing results.
Hot-bias coil performance and fault/surge/EMC qualification are before powered-use/product acceptance, not automatic evidence needed to etch an unpopulated board.
still_required_before_assembled_unit_acc: Sample/jig verification of customT1 and RF1/R7/C6 forming, mounting/vent and wire support.
Named qualified operator, complete guarded test fixture, explicit voltage/current/temperature stop limits and verified coil before switching.
Current/OVP/start/restart limits, drain/diode stress, fault coordination/saturation and all unverified thermal behavior.
before_bare_board_order_vs_later.formal_gate: Existing full-product Toolkit releaseFAIL cannot be relabeledPASS. A prototype-specific bounded requirements/release packet must preserve original product obligations and actual user authorization without fabricating approvals or measurements.

actionable_fixes.fix: Distinguish estimated total regulator current135.203mA from first-order external LED current133.439mA@60V; update LED-only nominal power8.006W consistently.
Define.9–1.7W total base-loss boundary including bleed. Pin/efficiency/inputRMS must use same boundary and explicit PF assumptions.
Label thermal scenarios unvalidated assumptions. T1 worst scenario108C exceeds90C target; do not state thermal design closed. Any better guarantee needs supplier/model/test.
Separate unpowered bare PCB order eligibility from assembled/powered/product release; do not erase original qualification gates or imply etching grants safe operation.
